violations.evidence: The inspected HTTP request passes verify=False, disabling server certificate verification.
violations.recommendation: Enable certificate verification; configure a trusted CA bundle if a private certificate authority is required.

violations.description: No CI configuration validates the application
violations.evidence: Tracked-file inspection found application source but no GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Travis, Jenkins or Azure Pipelines configuration.
violations.recommendation: Add CI that runs the existing test and lint commands on pull requests and pushes to the main branch.
